primary_method.name: U_fg
primary_method.selection_criterion: Minimal AURC(1-DSC) = 0.0839 on validation, Area-Robust (rho=-0.085 vs area)

prespecified_comparator.name: U_std_fg
prespecified_comparator.formula: U_std_fg = sqrt( (1 / |Omega_fg|) * sum_{i in Omega_fg} (H(p_i) - U_fg)^2 )
prespecified_comparator.rationale: Measures spatial contour dissonance; statistically indistinguishable from U_fg (Delta AURC = -0.0011, p=0.884)

setting_A.description: Lesion segmentation cohort (N=65); evaluates confidence exclusively on detected lesion candidates

setting_B.description: Two-stage clinical screening workflow: if |Omega_fg| == 0 and U_mean <= tau_neg (1e-4), accept as confident negative; if U_mean > tau_neg, abstain (trigger expert review); if |Omega_fg| > 0, score = U_fg

methodological_caveats: Validation cohort size is limited (N=65 lesion, N=13 normal).
Point estimate of U_fg is nominally superior to U_std_fg (AURC 0.0839 vs 0.0850), but paired bootstrap CI overlaps zero (Delta = -0.0011 [-0.0163, +0.0141], p=0.884).
Global U_mean is confounded by lesion area (rho = +0.9148 with count_fg); cannot be used alone for selective prediction on lesions.
Empty mask does not guarantee absence of lesion under domain shift (confidently missed lesions remain a theoretical vulnerability).

primary_operating_point.name: coverage_80
primary_operating_point.rationale: Exact integer coverage on validation (52/65) with peak clinically viable DSC improvement (+0.0390 vs baseline 0.8520)
